source.note: Companion to man-suit (wave-1 rows 74/67): Suit_Female from the same Quaternius Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019) on OpenGameArt, same zip, rig and clips as man-suit and woman-casual (idle, walk, punch, hit, sit and six more; no run, jump or death clip).
